attrs.label: Public URL
attrs.description:
The address users open. With a reverse proxy, its HTTPS address (for example https://ebbwell.example.com):</br>
passwords are then never accepted through that domain when sign-in is limited to the local network.</br>
For a LAN-only install without a domain, the NAS address (for example http://192.168.1.10:30000).

attrs.label: Data Encryption Key
attrs.description:
Encrypts all health data at rest. 32 random bytes, base64-encoded (create with: openssl rand -base64 32).</br>
Keep a copy somewhere safe: without it the data and backups cannot be decrypted.

attrs.label: Password Sign-in (Local Accounts)
attrs.description:
Where local accounts (username + password) may sign in.</br>
- Disabled: Only single sign-on is available.</br>
- Local Network: Sign-in from your LAN by the NAS address, never through the public domain (recommended).</br>
- Everywhere: Sign-in also through the public domain from the internet (not recommended).

attrs.label: Two-Factor Authentication (Local Accounts)
attrs.description: Authenticator-app codes for local accounts. Required forces every local user to set it up at next sign-in.

attrs.label: Local Networks
attrs.description: Networks (CIDR) considered local, in addition to loopback (127.0.0.0/8, ::1/128), which always is.

attrs.label: Administrator Username
attrs.description: Local administrator, created at startup if it doesn't exist yet. It creates the other local accounts.

schema.valid_chars_error: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

attrs.label: Administrator Password
attrs.description: Initial password of that administrator, used only when the account is created.

attrs.label: Trusted Proxies
attrs.description: Addresses of your reverse proxy (IPs, CIDRs or loopback / linklocal / uniquelocal), used to see real client IPs.

attrs.label: Backup Retention (Days)
attrs.description: Daily encrypted database backups are kept in the data storage for this many days. 0 disables them.

attrs.label: Additional Environment Variables
attrs.description:
Configure additional environment variables for Ebbwell.</br>
Single sign-on (OpenID Connect) is set up here: OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET, ...

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.
